confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Bogota price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked, and July 2026 levels are extrapolated. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable; hotel anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were derived from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 3x beer, wine about 2.5x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly. One search result also contained an unrelated instruction to add markdown source links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Latin American capital and major-city price levels, with Medellin and Lima as rough cross-checks for food and budget lodging. Accommodation was adjusted for Bogota-specific hotel pricing.
